info.title: Zeus Local API
info.description: Local JSON API for managing Hermes bot profiles and gateway lifecycle.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: Present only when Zeus replays a stored idempotent response.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying an in-progress idempotent request.

desired_state.description: Persisted operator intent for the gateway.

converged.description: True only when observed status matches desired state.

get.description: Authenticates the request, then opens the Zeus database read-only, requires the current schema version, and executes SELECT 1. The /v1/ready alias is provided by the versioned server URL.

200.description: The state store is readable at the current schema version

401.description: Missing API key, invalid API key, or API key not configured

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying authentication.

503.description: The API key is unconfigured or the state store is not ready
